## Descriptions

- **Acid Cloud** (`weapon.acid-cloud`): Pops open into a sickly yellow-green cloud that hangs over the hit for six turns and sails slowly with the wind, so it can drift onto someone else. At the end of every turn it rains corrosive drops that pit the ground, and every tank under it loses 30 shield points and then 4 health. Unlike Acid Rain it doesn't fall in one go: it keeps raining wherever the wind takes it.
- **Acid Rain** (`weapon.acid-rain`): Bursts at the top of its arc into a shower of acid. It eats brick, wood and glass for three turns and leaves dirt and rock almost untouched: strips a building to the ground.
- **Baby Digger** (`weapon.baby-digger`): Bores a short tunnel through the ground the way it was flying.
- **Baby Missile** (`weapon.baby-missile`): A Missile with half the bang. Cheap and plentiful.
- **Baby Nuke** (`weapon.baby-nuke`): A very big bang. Carves a deep crater and hurts everything in it. It pulls in with a small pop, then the main blast throws up a mushroom cloud and a shockwave.
- **Baby Roller** (`weapon.baby-roller`): Lands, then rolls downhill into the nearest dip or tank and goes off there.
- **Baby Shockwave** (`weapon.baby-shockwave`): A small ring of force: enough to fill a crater or nudge a tank off a ledge.
- **Black Hole Mine** (`weapon.black-hole-mine`): Lands quietly and sits on the ground. It arms when your turn ends, then waits: the first tank to come close, drive past or get blown onto it wakes a tiny black hole that drags the ground and every tank nearby into itself and swallows them whole. A tank already in reach when it arms sets it off at once; a blast also sets it off.
- **Bog Flask** (`weapon.bog-flask`): A glass jug of marsh gas. It smashes into a green haze that does nothing at all, hangs low and drifts with the wind, until any flame, lava or burning shot touches it and the whole cloud goes up in a rolling chain of flares.
- **Bumper** (`weapon.bumper`): A pinball bumper post pops up where it lands and kicks every enemy tank nearby clean across the map. The closer they are, the farther they fly; they bounce off hills and the map's edges and take fall damage where they land, unless a parachute opens.
- **Bunker Buster** (`weapon.bunker-buster`): A hardened, heavy shell that doesn't go off on contact. It punches straight on through the ground along its flight line, through rock, ice and roofs alike, and goes off the moment it breaks into open air beneath: inside the cave, the ice cage or under the ledge a tank is hiding in. Through solid ground with no hollow it goes off deep once its punch runs out (about 60 cells of dirt, or 24 of rock).
- **Burrower** (`weapon.burrower`): Burrows into the ground, then goes off at the end of its tunnel: hits tanks behind cover and under overhangs.
- **Caltrop Field** (`weapon.caltrop-field`): Bursts on the ground into a carpet of steel spikes about seventy cells wide. The spikes stay for eight turns. Standing still on them is safe, but every cell a tank drives across them costs 2 health and burns triple fuel and drive: bots won't drive onto them at all. Shell a hill pass with it and nobody gets through cheaply.
- **Chain Reactor** (`weapon.chain-reactor`): Splits open and soaks the ground around the impact with glowing reactor fuel, then sets it critical. The reaction creeps through the soaked ground and goes off in blast after blast, one setting off the next, until the whole patch has burned down to cinder. Fuel the chain misses stays live: the next blast, fire or lava nearby sets it off again.
- **Cluster Fireworks** (`weapon.cluster-fireworks`): A fizzing rocket that pops at the top of its arc and sends five fireworks climbing on up, each one higher than the last. They burst one after another in a rolling chain of colourful stars across the sky, and the burning stars drift down on the wind and pepper the ground below with little hot pops.
- **Cryo Shell** (`weapon.cryo-shell`): Freezes the ground into ice: a bunker that shrugs off blasts, or a block a tank cannot get out of.
- **Daisy Cutter** (`weapon.daisy-cutter`): A huge bomb that goes off flat instead of round. Its blast races out sideways along the ground for 140 cells each way and shaves every hill in its path off down to the height where it landed, throwing a low sheet of dirt outward, then the blast wave throws tanks away to the sides. Drop it in a valley to raze the hills around it. Rock and ice hold.
- **Decoy Tank** (`weapon.decoy-tank`): Lob it where you want the enemy to look. It lands softly and unfolds into a dummy tank in your colours. Bots can't tell it from the real thing and shoot at it, and homing warheads (Heat Seeker, Smart Bomb, V3 Rocket, Plasma Orb) lock on to it first. It soaks 50 damage, then pops in a burst of scrap.
- **Digger** (`weapon.digger`): Tunnels through the hill along its flight line: dig out a buried tank, or undercut one.
- **Dirt Ball** (`weapon.dirt-ball`): Drops a ball of dirt where it lands. Bury a tank, plug a crater or build cover.
- **Dirt Bomb** (`weapon.dirt-bomb`): Bursts into a huge dome of dry dirt that rains down over a wide stretch of the map: a blanket with banks on both sides that buries every tank under it.
- **Dirt Charge** (`weapon.dirt-charge`): Pushes a narrow column of dirt up out of the ground where it lands: lifts a tank into the open or walls it off.
- **Dirt Clod** (`weapon.dirt-clod`): A small clump of dirt. Patch a hole or top up a wall.
- **Dirt Tsunami** (`weapon.dirt-tsunami`): The ground at the impact rears up into a rolling wave of real dirt that runs away from you, growing as it scoops the surface, lifting tanks onto its crest and dumping them under the heap where it crashes.
- **Drill Torpedo** (`weapon.drill-torpedo`): Lands, then burrows on along the ground the way it was flying, heaving the soil above it like a mole run, and drills straight up to go off right under the first enemy tank it passes beneath. Land it short of a tank hiding behind a hill. It surfaces on its own after a long run.
- **Earth Bridge** (`weapon.earth-bridge`): Lands with a thump and grows a causeway of rammed earth back towards you, from where it hit to where you stand, never too steep to drive. Bridge a valley, ramp up a cliff to a better firing spot, or lay a road across a crater to drive over to a ledge. Piers drop to the ground under it where they can reach; a long span with nothing below may break off. Does no damage.
- **Earthquake** (`weapon.earthquake`): Shakes the whole map from the impact outward: loose ground jumps, overhangs and ledges collapse and perched tanks come down.
- **Fault Line** (`weapon.fault-line`): Splits the ground open. Fissures crack outward from the impact and spew dirt over everything near them, the ground under the hit drops into a rift valley while the slabs beside it heave up, and tanks ride up, topple into the chasms or end up buried. Magma glows at the bottom of the deepest cracks.
- **Flood** (`weapon.flood`): Dumps a wall of water that runs downhill, washes sand and ash away, erodes the dirt it crosses, puts out fires and quenches lava into rock.
- **Frost Bomb** (`weapon.frost-bomb`): Bursts in a blinding flash of cold. A frost front races across the hillside and glazes it slippery, so tanks slide down frosted slopes until it thaws into mud two turns later. Water freezes over, and any tank caught in it is frosted: its next shot fires at no more than half power.
- **Fuel-Air Bomb** (`weapon.fuel-air-bomb`): Bursts open into a cloud of fuel vapour that billows out for over a second, hugging the ground, pouring into dips and drifting with the wind. Then the whole cloud ignites at once: every puff goes up in fire, the crater takes the shape of the cloud, and the blast wave throws tanks and loose ground outward.
- **Glue Bomb** (`weapon.glue-bomb`): A fat glob of industrial glue that bursts in a stringy splat. Any tank it gums up is stuck fast for its next turn: it can't drive away, and blasts, slick slopes, quakes, waves and twisters can't budge it sideways. Light damage, big nuisance.
- **Gravity Well** (`weapon.gravity-well`): A defensive weapon. Opens a pocket of collapsed space that floats over where the shell lands and stays for two full rounds of turns. Enemy shells that fly anywhere near it curve in, slow down, spiral and get swallowed without going off. Your own side's shells fly straight through. Lob it just in front of yourself and let them come.
- **Grim Crown** (`weapon.grim-crown`): A bigger MIRV: seven heavy warheads split at the apex and level a stretch of the map.
- **Heat Seeker** (`weapon.heat-seeker`): Locks on to the nearest enemy tank and steers hard for it. Terrain still gets in the way.
- **Heavy Digger** (`weapon.heavy-digger`): Drives a wide, long tunnel deep through the hill.
- **Heavy Laser** (`weapon.heavy-laser`): A thicker, longer beam that slices clean through the map and hits hard. Crystal mirrors it.
- **Heavy Nuke** (`weapon.heavy-nuke`): The end of the hill. A blast so wide it reshapes the whole map around the impact. It pulls in with a small pop, then the main blast throws up a mushroom cloud and a shockwave.
- **Heavy Roller** (`weapon.heavy-roller`): A big Roller: rolls into the low ground and takes the valley with it.
- **Heavy Shockwave** (`weapon.heavy-shockwave`): A huge ring of force. Bulldozes the hill into a rampart, buries anyone close and throws tanks off their perches.
- **Hot Napalm** (`weapon.hot-napalm`): A bigger, hotter splash of burning jelly that floods a valley with fire.
- **Ice Wall** (`weapon.ice-wall`): Lands with a cold crack and grows a tall wall of ice out of the ground: cover to hide behind. Drop it right next to a tank and the ice cages it instead, a wall on each side and a roof over its turret, so it has to blast its way out.
- **Implosion** (`weapon.implosion`): Pulls the ground in: it heaps into a mound on the impact point and drags nearby tanks toward it, leaving whoever ends up on top exposed.
- **Incendiary** (`weapon.incendiary`): A low-blast fire shell. Barely scratches the dirt, but sets every wooden prop and oiled slope in range alight, and the fire spreads.
- **Ion Cannon** (`weapon.ion-cannon`): Lob a targeting beacon like a shell. A satellite charges up over it, then a colossal ion beam slams down from the sky: a blast twice the size of a Heavy Nuke, a storm of huge electric bolts instead of a mushroom cloud, and three shockwaves rolling out one after another, each shoving the ground around.
- **Kaiju** (`weapon.kaiju`): Summons a huge mud monster that claws its way up out of the ground where the shell lands and stays for three full rounds of turns. Any enemy tank that comes near gets picked up and hurled to slam into the ground far away, any enemy shell that flies past it is caught and thrown to a random spot on the map, and houses and trees in reach are ripped apart. It never touches you or your team.
- **Laser** (`weapon.laser`): A straight beam along your aim: no arc, no wind. Cuts a thin channel through the hill and hurts the first tank it reaches. Crystal mirrors it: the beam bounces off and carries on.
- **Lightning** (`weapon.lightning`): Calls a bolt down from the sky onto the highest enemy tank, wherever it is. The strike fuses the crater walls into glass and sends arcs crawling along the ground. Aim does not matter; cover overhead does.
- **Liquid Dirt** (`weapon.liquid-dirt`): A splash of runny mud that flows downhill into every hole and tunnel, then sets hard as dirt.
- **Magma Bomb** (`weapon.magma-bomb`): Erupts on impact: melts the ground into lava and throws glowing lava bombs that land as small pools of their own. The lava runs downhill and pools; tanks sitting in it burn every turn until it cools to rock three turns later.
- **Magnet Mine** (`weapon.magnet-mine`): Beds in where it lands, then switches on a strong magnet: tanks nearby are dragged along the ground and clamped onto it, and metal in the ground is torn loose and flies in. When the field runs out, the mine goes off with everything stuck to it.
- **Meteor Shower** (`weapon.meteor-shower`): Marks the ground where it lands and calls down a shower of burning meteors. A dozen streak in out of the sky behind you over a couple of seconds, pounding the ground around the mark into glowing craters that scorch any tank sitting in them.
- **MIRV** (`weapon.mirv`): Splits into five warheads at the top of its arc with a bright pop. They fan out and come down in a line, each one throwing up a geyser of dirt and shoving the ground aside.
- **Missile** (`weapon.missile`): The workhorse shell. A standard blast where it lands.
- **Mud Geyser** (`weapon.mud-geyser`): Punches a vent into the ground and a towering column of boiling mud erupts out of it. The ground around the vent soaks into soft mud, and the column rains back down as scalding globs.
- **Mystery Shell** (`weapon.mystery`): Turns into a random weapon at the top of its arc. Could be a nuke, could be a clod of dirt.
- **Napalm** (`weapon.napalm`): Splashes burning jelly that runs downhill, scorches the dirt to ash and burns any tank it reaches.
- **Nuke** (`weapon.nuke`): The biggest bang in the shop. Clears a hillside and anyone standing on it. It pulls in with a small pop, then the main blast throws up a mushroom cloud and a shockwave.
- **Oil Slick** (`weapon.oil-slick`): Bursts into a slick that coats the ground. Oiled terrain holds together against shockwaves and moves as one blob, but a single spark sets the whole slope on fire.
- **Orbital Lance** (`weapon.orbital-lance`): Lob a beacon like a shell. Where it lands a satellite locks on, then a white-hot beam comes straight down from the sky and bores a deep shaft, melting its walls to glowing slag and charring the ground around it. Cover overhead does not help. Crystal does: the beam is thrown back to the sky.
- **Plague** (`weapon.plague`): Leaves a sickly cloud where it lands. Every tank inside it loses health at the end of each turn for four turns.
- **Plasma Blast** (`weapon.plasma-blast`): A white-hot blast that melts a crater, splashes fire and sets anything wooden nearby alight.
- **Plasma Cannon** (`weapon.plasma-cannon`): Fires a hot bolt of blue-violet plasma on a flat, fast arc: it drops less than half as much as a shell and the wind can't touch it. Where it hits it bursts in a plasma ring that throws tanks and splashes a glowing pool of plasma that runs downhill, burns tanks sitting in it and eats its way down into the ground before it cools to glass.
- **Plasma Orb** (`weapon.plasma-orb`): Lands and lets loose a crackling ball of plasma. It climbs into the air, creeps toward the nearest enemy and lashes anyone in reach with arcs, then bursts in a plasma shockwave that throws tanks and buildings.
- **Portal Pair** (`weapon.portal-pair`): Opens two linked rings that stay for three full rounds of turns: one where the shell lands and its twin just in front of your tank. Any shell that flies into one ring shoots out of the other at the same speed and heading, and any tank that drives, falls or is thrown into one steps out beside the other. Lob shells into your near ring to drop them on whoever sits by the far one, but they work for everyone, so watch your own back.
- **Quicksand** (`weapon.quicksand`): Turns the ground into flowing mud for a few seconds. The hill slumps, tunnels fill, and tanks on the slope slide to the bottom.
- **Railgun** (`weapon.railgun`): A hyper-velocity slug fired flat along your aim: power doesn't matter, the wind can't touch it and it barely drops. It punches through a thin ridge, a wall or a house and hits the first tank in line hard, but a real hill stops it. A sniper's shot: aim the line, not the arc.
- **Repair Drone** (`weapon.repair-drone`): Pops open where it lands and lets loose a little repair drone that flies to the nearest friendly tank (yours, or a teammate's) and hovers over it, patching its armour: 15 HP when it arrives, then 10 more at the start of every turn for two rounds, never above round-start health. Land it near the tank you want mended. Enemies can shoot it down: any shell passing close by, or going off near it, knocks it out of the sky. Does no damage.
- **Resonator** (`weapon.resonator`): Harmless on impact, but it leaves the ground ringing: the next explosion inside its field goes off twice as big.
- **Ricochet Ball** (`weapon.ricochet-ball`): A ball of crackling energy that rebounds off the ground at the angle it came in, five times, throwing sparks and burning hotter with every bounce, then goes off in a white-hot burst. Bank it off a slope or a wall onto a tank hiding behind cover. A tank in its path sets it off at once.
- **Riot Blast** (`weapon.riot-blast`): A wide, clean hole that hurts nobody: clear a whole hilltop of cover.
- **Riot Bomb** (`weapon.riot-bomb`): A huge harmless crater. Drops everyone standing near it into the pit.
- **Riot Charge** (`weapon.riot-charge`): Blows a clean hole in the ground and hurts nobody. Dig out a buried tank or cut the hill from under one.
- **Rogue Black Hole** (`weapon.rogue-hole`): Opens a black hole that roams the map for two full rounds of turns. At the start of every turn it drifts along the ground, away from you at first and bouncing off the map edges, eating a tunnel through everything in its way. Shells that fly near it, yours too, are bent in and eaten. Tanks nearby are dragged toward it, and any tank it touches gets bitten. It evaporates with a pop when its time is up.
- **Roller** (`weapon.roller`): Lands, then rolls downhill along the ground until it meets a tank, a wall or the bottom of a valley. Perfect for tanks hiding in holes.
- **Scatter Bomb** (`weapon.scatter-bomb`): Bursts on impact and flings a fan of bomblets across the ground around it.
- **Shield Breaker** (`weapon.shield-breaker`): An EMP shell. It barely scratches the ground, but the pulse that rolls out from it collapses every shield in reach, cooks the spare batteries in their holds, and fries their electrics so they can't drive or switch on gear on their next turn. Crack a turtle open, then hit it with something real.
- **Shockwave** (`weapon.shockwave`): Leaves no crater. A ring of force shoves the hill outward, fills nearby holes and pushes tanks off their perches.
- **Singularity** (`weapon.singularity`): Pulls the ground into a heap on the impact point, hangs there for a moment, then blows it all outward. Late-game, and priced like it.
- **Sinkhole** (`weapon.sinkhole`): Hollows out a cavern under the impact. The ground sags and rumbles for a moment, then drops out from under everything: tanks on it fall to the bottom of a deep pit with sheer walls and have to climb or drive their way out.
- **Skipper** (`weapon.skipper`): Goes off where it lands, bounces on and goes off again, three times in all, hopping along the ground.
- **Smart Bomb** (`weapon.smart-bomb`): Drifts gently toward the nearest enemy tank once it has flown a while. Forgives a near miss.
- **Spotter Flare** (`weapon.spotter-flare`): A recon shot. It does no harm: it bursts into a burning red flare that spots every enemy tank within 48 cells. Until the end of your next turn your whole team hits spotted tanks 50% harder, and everyone on your team sees the full flight path of their next shot as they aim, wind and all. Spot first, then land the big one.
- **Supernova** (`weapon.supernova`): Lights a small star over where it lands. For five long seconds the star burns and pulls: the ground around it is torn up and sucked in, and every tank nearby is dragged toward it. Then it collapses and goes off in a huge ring that flings tanks across the map, and leaves the crater glazed in glowing slag.
- **Superstorm** (`weapon.superstorm`): Thunderstorm and Ion Cannon in one. The beacon calls black clouds rolling in from both edges of the sky until they meet in one storm over the whole map. For three turns it rains everywhere, every tank rusts, and at the end of each turn a barrage of huge ion-fat lightning bolts hammers down all over the map, one after another.
- **Swap Ray** (`weapon.swap-ray`): A straight beam along your aim that passes through hills without a scratch. When it reaches a tank, you and that tank both break apart into pixels and trade places. Harmless, but it puts an enemy on your crumbling cliff, in your pit, or right next to someone else's nuke. If it reaches no tank, nothing happens.
- **Tectonic Charge** (`weapon.tectonic-charge`): A shockwave that runs along the surface: a wave of dirt rolls out both ways across the map, lifting tanks and dropping them in its wake.
- **Telepathy** (`weapon.telepathy`): A humming violet thought-orb that bursts in rings of psychic static. Any enemy tank caught in the rings is yours for its next turn: you aim it, pick from its own arsenal, drive it and pull the trigger. Turn it on its friends, march it off a cliff, or make it spend its nuke on itself. A bot caster turns the victim on its own side. Breaks if you die first.
- **Teleport Shell** (`weapon.teleport-shell`): Harmless on its own: wherever the shell lands, your tank breaks apart into pixels, streaks across the sky and pulls itself back together right there, standing on the ground. Hop out of a pit, onto the high ground, or right next to an enemy for a point-blank shot next turn. Land it on a tank and you come out beside it.
- **Terraformer** (`weapon.terraformer`): Grows a wall of dirt where it lands: cover between you and the shooter, or a ramp up to the high ground.
- **Thunderstorm** (`weapon.thunderstorm`): A small crackling bomb that brews a black thundercloud over where it lands. The storm hangs there for four turns, raining on everything beneath it. Tanks caught under it rust: they lose a little health every turn for three turns, their tracks grind (half the driving) and their barrels shake (shots wobble a few degrees). Now and then a bolt of lightning cracks down out of the cloud somewhere under it.
- **Ton of Dirt** (`weapon.ton-of-dirt`): A whole hill of dirt at once. Anything under it is buried.
- **Tornado** (`weapon.tornado`): A funnel drops out of the sky where it lands and runs along the ground with the wind. It sucks up the dirt it crosses, picks up any tank in its path and hurls it, then flings everything it carried back down across the map.
- **Toxic Gas** (`weapon.toxic-gas`): Cracks open into a rolling green cloud. The gas is heavier than air: it spills downhill, pools in valleys and craters, and drifts with the wind. Every tank caught in it chokes at the end of each turn for four turns, and the grass it creeps over withers.
- **Tracer** (`weapon.tracer`): No blast at all: shows where a shot with this aim lands. Cheap practice for the real thing.
- **Trencher** (`weapon.trencher`): Digs a deep trench where it lands. Drop a tank into a pit it has to shoot its way out of.
- **Tripwire Net** (`weapon.tripwire-net`): Drives two stakes into the ground about sixty cells apart and strings a thin wire between them, a few cells up. It arms when your turn ends. The first tank to drive or fall into the wire, or the first shell to fly through it, snaps it: a weighted net drops where it was hit, banging hard and pinning every tank under it so it can't drive for two turns. A blast at either stake snaps it too.
- **V3 Rocket** (`weapon.v3-rocket`): A three-stage monster. It lobs like a shell, then a moment after launch the booster roars alight and drives it straight up into the high sky, dropping a burning spent stage at each burn-out. Up there the warhead turns over, locks on to the enemy tank nearest below it and screams down on it in a steep powered dive: a deep crater and a shockwave that throws tanks and houses.
- **Volcano Seed** (`weapon.volcano-seed`): Plants itself in the ground and a cinder cone shoots up around it, tanks riding up its slopes. At the end of this turn and the next three, the crater erupts: it spits real lava high into the air and slops it over the rim. The lava rains down, runs downhill and pools, burns any tank sitting in it, and cools to rock.
- **Water Cannon** (`weapon.water-cannon`): A jet of water along your aim. No blast: it washes sand and ash away, cools lava and shoves a tank it hits.
